meta.source: Census American Community Survey 2020–2024 5-year estimates, B25064
meta.method: Published place or county median gross rent; no tract averaging
meta.notes: Each row is the published median for that geography. Suppressed or missing estimates stay null with a reason; no county or tract value is substituted.
meta.scope: Colorado: 64 counties, 482 places and CDPs (including unavailable rows)
